audience: product teams that plan and share roadmaps in Roadmunk

useCases.title: Summarize a roadmap for a status update
useCases.text: List the roadmaps and read the items of one. Ask the assistant for a short summary by status.

useCases.title: Find items by keyword
useCases.text: Search the roadmap items and read one item with its field values and dates.

useCases.title: Add a new item to a roadmap
useCases.text: Create a roadmap item from a request. Fill in the title and the fields of your roadmap.

useCases.title: Move an item after a plan change
useCases.text: Find the item and update its fields, for example the status or the dates.

useCases.title: Track and plan milestones
useCases.text: List the milestones, then create a new one or update the date of an existing one.
